name: Collateral Transaction Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of collateral instruction as a code.

AADJ.name: Allocation Mode Adjustment
AADJ.definition: Automatic/manual settlement adjustment to change the allocation mode from manual to automatic or vice  versa.

CADJ.name: Collateral Adjustment
CADJ.definition: Change to collateral. Used  when collateral giver manually allocates the securities to the transaction.

INIT.name: Initiation
INIT.definition: Creation of a Collateral Management Transaction.

TERM.name: Termination
TERM.definition: Closing of the Collateral Management Transaction.
